title: 11x7 Bellerose Greenhouse
current_description:
Glazing is what separates greenhouses at this size, and the Bellerose uses 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate rated at R-2.1, retaining 30% more heat than the standard 6mm twin-wall panels. It diffuses the light coming through, so plants get coverage without scorching.
The frame is FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar, which naturally resists rot, decay and insects. Inside there are 83 square feet of floor and 40 linear feet of staging shelves, some fixed and some foldable, and the entry door is sized wide enough for a wheelbarrow. A water spigot is fitted inside for watering without dragging a hose in.
Airflow is handled two ways, by one thermostat-activated exhaust fan and two casement windows. An integrated pergola with a trellis roof defines the entrance for climbing vines and hanging plants. Pro-Tect tested to 5,700 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds, with a 5-year warranty backed by U.S.-based support.

title: 14x12 Larkspur Metal Greenhouse
current_description:
Floor area inside the Larkspur runs to 163 square feet, framed in black galvanized steel and aluminum on oversized 4.7-inch corner posts, with wood-tone composite paneling that needs no painting, sealing or staining. The glazing is 10mm four-wall polycarbonate rated R-2.1, which holds about 30 percent more heat than the 6mm twin-wall panels most greenhouses use and diffuses direct sun into softer light so plants are less likely to scorch in midsummer.
Ventilation works two ways, through two thermostat-activated exhaust fans and four windows with removable magnetic screens. Inside are 44 linear feet of upper and lower staging shelves built to hold up to 500 pounds each, an interior water spigot fed from an exterior inlet, and a collapsible hose. Residential-grade aluminum gutters carry roof runoff away from the foundation. Pro-Tect engineering rates the structure to 10,600 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds, and a 5-year warranty covers every component.
current_excerpt: A 163 square foot greenhouse in steel and aluminum, glazed with 10mm four-wall polycarbonate and vented by two thermostat-activated exhaust fans.
source_facts:
The Larkspur 14x12 metal greenhouse is built to commercial-grade standards and designed to earn its place in your backyard. It's made with a black, galvanized steel and aluminum frame, anchored by oversized 4.7-inch corner posts that bring the kind of structural strength you'd expect from a professional greenhouse. Wood-tone composite paneling and a modern silhouette make it a structure that adds architectural presence to your yard, not just a place to work in. The Larkspur comes with 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate glazing with an R-2.1 insulation value that retains 30% more heat than the standard 6mm twin-wall most greenhouses use, extending your growing season and diffusing direct sun into soft, even light so plants don't scorch in peak summer. Residential-grade aluminum gutters come standard, channeling rainwater off the roof away from the foundation and making it easier to collect for irrigation. Pro-Tect engineered for real weather, the Larkspur is rated to withstand up to 10,600 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds. It’s all backed by a comprehensive 5-year warranty on every component, from the framing and polycarbonate to every feature. 

• Galvanized steel and aluminum frame with wood-tone composite paneling for low-maintenance, all-weather strength with no painting, sealing, or staining 

• 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate with R-2.1 insulation retains 30% more heat than standard 6mm twin-wall 

• 2 thermostat-activated exhaust fans plus 4 windows with removable magnetic screens for active and passive airflow 

• 163 sq ft interior with 44 linear feet of upper and lower staging shelves, built to hold up to 500 lbs per shelf 

• Interior water spigot and exterior inlet with collapsible hose included for watering inside the greenhouse 

• Residential-grade aluminum gutters to route rainwater off the roof and away from the foundation 

• Pro-Tect™ tested to withstand 10,600 lbs of snow and 100 mph winds with oversized 4.7" corner posts 

• Comprehensive 5-year warranty with U.S.-based 7-day support and 48-hour parts shipping
